text:
Brady Tkachuk asked out of Ottawa, and in June the Senators sent their captain of five seasons to Florida for two first-round picks in the 2026 draft, a conditional first in 2029 and a second. Twenty-one games into life beside his brother, the Panthers look like they got exactly the player they paid for.

He has 11 goals and 23 points, 15 of them on the power play, and leads the team with 76 shots and 82 hits. The goals are honest: 11 on 9.9 expected. Florida takes 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice, and by our wins-added measure he's ninth of 528 skaters, with goals that have swung games.

The game is the same one Ottawa knew. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 1.5 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net last season, and 19% of his own setups come from behind the net, more than double a typical forward. Evolving-Hockey said he drove play at the 99th percentile. The difference now is the company.
